summary: Resolves the six self-review findings, then the ten an adversarial review raised against those fixes: node identity in lock-import and maven, ordered-set collation in the Rust amend path, the gc reference closure, and tests that passed under the very bugs they claimed to cover.
residuals: Nothing populates store references yet; gc computes the closure correctly in advance of that.
No JS producer applies the universe-v1 ordered-set projection, so the Rust amend path is the only implementation that sorts and nothing cross-checks the two.
PREX captures and verifies; it does not build or evaluate.
